import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 5, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (5, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'cluster_{v}' for v in k]
df['title'] = [f'Point {i}' for i in range(n)]
